csv_project_name: AE for Midwest Campus Chilled Water Connection
csv_scope_of_work: This project prepares existing buildings in the midwest campus area to receive and utilize distribution chilled water from the Combined Heating Power (CHP) plant. A future project will connect buidlings to distributed hot water from the CHP plant. The critertia documents shall include both chilled and heating water building modifications, phased for chilled water connects to occur first. Heating water conections shall not require chilled water re-work. All work in occupied spaces shall occur during the chilled water phase. Criteria AE services shall include project planning, engineering and design services for the development of Design Build criteria documents to upgrade and prepare buildings HVAC systems. Services will also include scope prioritization for repair with probable cost information.
